# Relay

Relay forwards webhook events to internal consumers. It listens on port 8080 by default.

## Setup

1. Install the `relay` binary.
2. Set `RELAY_TOKEN`.
3. Run `relay serve`.

## Retries

Failed deliveries are retried 3 times with a fixed 5 second delay.

graph LR
  A[Webhook] --> B[Relay]
